headline: Take-Two (NASDAQ:TTWO) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q4 CY2025
summary: Video game publisher Take Two (NASDAQ:TTWO) reported Q4 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 24.9% year on year to $1.70 billion. While "GTA VI" is expected to make the company billions at launch, ⁠investors will also ‌look at how Take-Two and developers Rockstar Games plan to update the title ‍post launch to keep players engaged and spending on its online features.
